scope: Historical scheduler-run, event dead-letter, and MQTT-delivery error display

behavior.scheduler_runs: The run list retains failure presence but replaces persisted error text with a redacted marker.
behavior.event_dead_letters: Dead-letter identity, event type, failure count, timestamp, and disposition remain visible; raw persisted diagnostics are redacted.
behavior.mqtt_deliveries: Delivery ID, state, attempt count, and timestamps remain in JSON output; the stored last_error is replaced with a redacted marker.

coverage: scheduler run output excludes historic raw error text
event dead-letter output excludes historic raw error text
MQTT delivery JSON excludes last_error contents while preserving delivery state and attempt count
record metadata and connection/cursor cleanup remain intact

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; synthetic rows and fake connections

limitations: No database, worker, or event handler was executed.
The CLI displays an error marker but does not expose historical diagnostics.
